t: You're on Throgmorton Street, a road in the City of London running between Lothbury to the west and Old Broad Street to the east. Throgmorton Avenue branches off its north side and runs up to London Wall. The street takes its name from Sir Nicholas Throckmorton, an English diplomat and politician. He served as ambassador to France and later Scotland, and played a key role in the relationship between Elizabeth the First and Mary, Queen of Scots.
